data.name: label4.Text
data.value: Career opportunities for BSHM graduates are diverse, offering paths into the dynamic hospitality and tourism industries. Graduates can pursue roles in hotel management, including positions as front office managers, guest relations managers, and food and beverage managers. They can also work in event planning and management, convention services, and catering coordination. Other career paths include roles in tourism management, resort management, and cruise line operations. Graduates may also find opportunities in restaurant management, spa and wellness management, and travel agencies. Additionally, they can explore careers in hospitality consulting, sales and marketing, and entrepreneurship within the hospitality sector. These roles capitalize on their skills in customer service, operations management, and event organization, providing avenues for growth and specialization in the hospitality industry.

data.name: label2.Text
data.value: The Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management (BSHM) is a ladderized baccalaureate program that equips students with the necessary 21st century hospitality competencies adept to the local and global needs of employment. Graduates of BSHM have sufficient exposure to laboratory and industry immersions aligned with TESDA and ASEAN Common Competency qualifications and standards observed in foodservice, lodging and accommodation, and other tourism establishments. As PUP-trained hospitality professionals, graduates are expected to have developed strong service orientation, resiliency, and passion for lifelong learning.
